claim: The previously accepted build violates stable hover geometry, single-axis crop resizing, one-boundary corner geometry, screen-content provenance, and no-colored-leak invariants in the real Figma host.

screenshots.finding: Purple and magenta wedges remain visible beneath the imported phone content.
Pointer hover changes the sample-card geometry and produces severe rotation and jitter.
Dragging one crop edge also moves the perpendicular edges.
Crop mode displays an unrelated rounded outer canvas boundary that does not match the asset aperture.
Colored corner leakage is present in the final visible mockup, so the earlier asset QA gate was incomplete.
The plugin injects a synthetic blue-purple default interface that was not supplied or approved by the decision owner.

supersedes: Any earlier claim that 99/99 automated checks alone were sufficient for acceptance of DEV-EE4E61CF1965
limits: These screenshots prove the observed failures in the named local build; they do not by themselves prove the corrected build passes.
